long_biography.plain_text:
Vural grew up around fishing in Istanbul, working with his father and uncle before studying geological engineering at Istanbul Technical University. He later moved to Bodrum and built Noordzee into his own aquaculture platform. Under his ownership, the business expanded from fish farming into an integrated system encompassing hatcheries, feed production, offshore farms, processing and packaging.

Noordzee raises sea bass, sea bream, trout and stone bass across several marine regions and sells extensively into export markets. Vural has paired that operating role with sustained industry representation, serving as president of the Aydın aquaculture producers’ association and on the national federation’s board. His career combines inherited sector knowledge with the acquisition and expansion of a separately controlled enterprise.
